name: 7-Eleven Distribution Co Cold Storage DC Santa Fe Springs CA

fieldNotes.truckGate: West driveway off Lakeland Rd is open pavement with only a painted STOP bar at the property line; no barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or checkpoint pinch-point. Confirmed in z21 satellite and Street View (Jan 2025) looking south down the drive.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure anywhere at the entrance or along the drive in satellite or Street View. Building office front and employee lobby face Lakeland Rd, but there is no truck-gate guard shack.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no controlled truck gate at all (no gate => not a remote/kiosk gate either).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Deep paved truck court south of the dock face holds queued/staged trailers before the doors.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Approach from Lakeland down the west drive into the court easily holds 3+ trucks; trailers were staged single-file along the drive in Street View.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: South face of the DC carries one long continuous dock bank; counted well over 50 doors with trailers backed in across the building width (z19 imagery). Additional E-series dock doors on the west wall.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large truck court packed with rows of parked trailers (no tractor) plus trailers backed at docks; estimated 50+ drop stalls. Count is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows fill the interior court, distinct from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Could not confirm two physically separate dock clusters; main dock bank is one continuous south face, so marked false (low confidence).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Santa Fe Springs / Los Angeles County industrial fabric, abundant surrounding development and an adjacent apartment complex.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Dense metro LA area; cellular coverage expected to be strong.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~14 acres for the fenced property (building + court + parking) derived from the perimeter polygon.
